description.summary: lock human input and protected outputs

protocol.description: This private protocol protects the human seat and all outputs except registered agent-private headless outputs. Authorized agent seats may continue using shared application windows. This is not ext-session-lock and does not promise a full session lock. A client disappearing never unlocks the human desktop. Secure is sent only after protected outputs have presented a lock/black frame or are off. Unknown and newly connected outputs are protected by default.

interface.name: cornice_session_guard_v1
interface.description: Loss of this guard during a human lock atomically escalates to an orphaned full lock and revokes all agent seats. It never unlocks.
